claim_boundary: The official repository exposes five archives whose filenames use 'sword', and the paper uses 'fencing' as an activity label. Visual review of the locally verified preview shows staged stick/sword sparring without a modern fencing piste, masks, uniforms, scoring apparatus, or epee/foil/sabre labels. It is therefore adjacent-domain pose and occlusion pretraining material, not three-weapon sport fencing data. Archive bytes and LFS SHA-256 values are exact remote inventory; the five 109 GiB archives were not acquired. Dataset-level counts are context only.
security_note: The hosting service flags serialized Python objects for review. Treat archives as trusted-source research inputs and inspect members before deserialization.
